subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI device tokens collide across same-origin gateway paths

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101352 be treated as the canonical fix for this credential-scope bug?
rationale: The issue has a protected maintainer label and the active fix changes bearer credential storage and migration behavior, which should be reviewed by a human before landing.

options.title: Review linked fix PR
options.body: Treat the linked endpoint-scoping PR as the canonical resolution path and review its migration, security, and E2E proof before merge.

options.title: Request a different storage design
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a revised PR if maintainers want a different endpoint identity or migration policy.

recommendation.title: Review linked fix PR
recommendation.body: Treat the linked endpoint-scoping PR as the canonical resolution path and review its migration, security, and E2E proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active candidate fix branch and issue context, so they are the best first routing point for PR follow-up.
